parameters.query:
select jarvis.export_all()::text as data, to_char(now() at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata', 'YYYY-MM-DD') as today,
  (select value #>> '{}' from jarvis.settings where key = 'backup_repo') as repo
insert into jarvis.settings (key, value) values ('backup_last_ok', to_jsonb(now()::text)) on conflict (key) do update set value = excluded.value

select
  (select value from jarvis.settings where key = 'email_status') as email_status,
  (select to_char(((value #>> '{}')::timestamptz) at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') from jarvis.settings where key = 'email_synced_at') as email_synced_at,
  (select to_char(((value #>> '{}')::timestamptz) at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') from jarvis.settings where key = 'backup_last_ok') as backup_last_ok,
  (select count(*) from jarvis.items
     where type = 'reminder' and status = 'open' and parent_id is null and last_notified_at is null
       and remind_at < now() - interval '90 minutes' and created_at < now() - interval '90 minutes')::int as missed_reminders

select $1::json as problems,
  (select value #>> '{}' from jarvis.settings where key = 'bark_key') as bark_key,
  (select value from jarvis.settings where key = 'health_alerts') as alerts

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ device_key: $json.bark_key, title: $json.title, body: $json.body, level: 'active', group: 'Jarvis alerts' }) }}

parameters.query: insert into jarvis.settings (key, value) values ('health_alerts', $1::jsonb) on conflict (key) do update set value = excluded.value
